title: Labeled Triangle
description: A triangle drawn from vertex coordinates, with author-selected side labels, angle labels, and an optional right-angle mark. Serves Geometry and Trigonometry (lines-angles-triangles, right-triangles-trig, area-volume): Pythagorean, trig-ratio, similarity, and area questions.

vertices.description: Vertices in a coordinate frame; renderer rejects collinear or near-coincident triples (min pairwise distance 1 unit, min angle 10°).

sideLabels.description: Text placed beside sides (lengths or expressions like 'x', '2x+3').

angleLabels.description: Text placed inside angles (measures or expressions like 'x°').

rightAngleAt.description: Vertex receiving the right-angle square mark; null for a general triangle. Renderer validates the geometry actually forms a 90° angle there (±0.5°).

notes: Renderer guarantees: the triangle is drawn from the vertex coordinates only — side labels are placed at side midpoints, offset outward so they never overlap edges or each other; angle labels sit on the angle bisector at a fixed radius; no grid or axes are drawn; degenerate (collinear/tiny) triangles are rejected at parse time.
